description: The plot illustrates the relationship between sample token count and the number of shared experts for two samples using different models. The x-axis is labeled "Sample Token Count", uses a logarithmic scale with base 2, ranges from 2<sup>9</sup> to 2<sup>20</sup>, and features tick labels at integer powers of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Shared Experts for Two Samples" and has a linear scale, ranging from 2.0 to 6.0 with tick labels at 0.5 intervals. A red line, labeled "Intent", begins at approximately 3.3 when the x-axis value is 2<sup>9</sup>, decreases to a minimum of 2.8 at 2<sup>11</sup>, and then increases to 5.5 by 2<sup>17</sup>, remaining relatively constant through 2<sup>20</sup>. A blue line, labeled "Summary", starts at 2.1 when the x-axis value is 2<sup>9</sup> and rises sharply to 5.7 by 2<sup>12</sup>, before leveling off and remaining near 5.7 through 2<sup>20</sup>. A yellow line, labeled "Law", begins at 3.8 at 2<sup>9</sup> and increases steadily to 5.8 by 2<sup>18</sup>, continuing to 5.9 at 2<sup>20</sup>. A purple line, labeled "Translation", starts at 4.2 at 2<sup>9</sup>, rises to 5.6 at 2<sup>14</sup>, and then levels off to approximately 5.6 through 2<sup>20</sup>. A green line, labeled "Math", begins at approximately 5.3 when the x-axis value is 2<sup>9</sup> and remains relatively consistent around 5.4 to 5.6 through 2<sup>20</sup>. A gray line rises slowly from around 2.1 at 2<sup>9</sup> to 3.2 at 2<sup>20</sup>.
